decisions.reason: Uses LinkType Junction + Target + cordis.patch.yml link marker to show the profile entry resolves to the repo tree; repo edits are the deployment, copying is a self-copy; contrasts with copied-install procedure.

Attributes EBUSY to the running dsh host holding lib files and stale in-memory module state; closing the tab releases nothing since the browser holds no file handles; separately explains browser HTTP-cache staleness requiring hard refresh after host restart.

Explains renames through the junction renamed the sole physical files and broke the follow-up copy; recovery renames .old2 files back preserving content, verifies with node --check (ESM variant noted), stops host first, no deletes or recreation.
Correct semantic order: stop host fully, restart dsh web, cache-bypassing hard refresh, then verify feature served/loaded and absence of load errors; syntax check explicitly not activation.
Pre-flight inspects LinkType/Target and link: marker before any file operation, branches linked vs copied procedure, and explains why generic copy-into-node_modules advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: Plan explicitly forbids copying through the junction and deleting .old2 files; the two paths are treated as one directory.
Plan requires full host stop/restart; browser refresh alone is explicitly rejected.
